description: This file contains shell functions related to creating tar archive members, specifically defining functions to print tar headers and content padding for archive creation.

methods.name: tar_print_member
methods.description: Creates a tar archive member with specified name and content, including header and padding, handling metadata such as permissions, ownership, and modification time.

methods.name: tar_print_trailer
methods.description: Outputs padding to mark the end of a tar archive.

methods.name: __tar_print_padding
methods.description: Outputs specified amount of null bytes or padding for tar archive formatting.
